documented_diagnosis.name: Melanoma
documented_diagnosis.evidence: Confirmed by biopsy, as recorded in PAD-UFES-20.

teaching_points: Check the ABCDEs: Asymmetry, Border irregularity, Colour variation, Diameter over 6 mm and Evolution.
This patch is asymmetric, with an irregular border and several shades of brown, and it has changed.
Change over time is the most important warning sign. Melanoma caught early is very treatable.

look_alikes.name: Atypical (dysplastic) nevus
look_alikes.note: Can share some ABCD features but is usually stable over time.

look_alikes.name: Seborrheic keratosis
look_alikes.note: Stuck-on, waxy surface; can be very dark.

look_alikes.name: Solar lentigo
look_alikes.note: Flat and evenly brown, on sun-damaged skin.
